description: A full boot of Ubuntu 24.04 with Linux 6.8.0-35-generic for X86. It runs `m5 exit` at specific times in the boot process. Please refer to the README for diskimage for more information. If specified the readfile will be executed after booting.
example_usage:
workload = board.set_workload(obtain_resource(resource_id="x86-ubuntu-24.04-boot-with-systemd"))
def exit_event_handler():
    print('first exit event: Kernel booted')
    yield False
    print('second exit event: In after boot')
    yield False
    print('third exit event: After run script')
    yield True

simulator = Simulator(
    board=board,
    on_exit_event={
        ExitEvent.EXIT: exit_event_handler(),
    },
)

description: A disk image containing Ubuntu 24.04 for x86. This image will run an `m5 readfile` instruction after booting. This diskimage will run m5 exit events 3 times: when kernel is booted, when after_boot script is run and after the run script is run.
author: Andreu Girones
example_usage:
workload = board.set_kernel_disk_workload(
    kernel=//obtain kernel,
    disk_image=obtain_resource(resource_id="x86-ubuntu-24.04-img"),
    bootloader=//bootloader resource,
)
def exit_event_handler():
    print('first exit event: Kernel booted')
    yield False
    print('second exit event: In after boot')
    yield False
    print('third exit event: After run script')
    yield True

simulator = Simulator(
    board=board,
    on_exit_event={
        ExitEvent.EXIT: exit_event_handler(),
    },
)
